summary: FitTrackee is a self-hosted application designed for recording and reviewing physical workouts and daily activities. Built with Python and distributed via Docker containers, it provides a centralised platform to manage your exercise logs. While the exact scope of supported sensors and metrics is undefined in the core description, it serves as a private alternative to commercial fitness platforms.
goodFor: This is a suitable option if you want to store your personal fitness logs on your own hardware rather than relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The project relies on the AGPL-3.0 licence, which has strict copyleft obligations if you modify and network the software, and it may lack the extensive integration ecosystem found in mainstream fitness apps.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running a Docker container, requiring you to configure persistent volumes for your workout data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
